patch_description:
Radically reduce parameter count through aggressive sharing while increasing entanglement:

1. Replace 8 independent RY gates with 2 shared RY parameters (even/odd qubits)
2. Replace 16 independent RZ gates with 2 shared RZ parameters (pre/post layers, all qubits)
3. Replace linear CZ chain with parametrized XX/YY gates on all neighbor pairs
4. Add a few strategic cross-chain gates for better long-range entanglement

This reduces distinct parameters from 24 to ~10-12, forcing the circuit to learn more generalizable patterns rather than memorizing training data. The parameter sharing acts as strong regularization. Parametrized two-qubit gates (XX, YY) replace fixed CZ gates, giving us more expressive power per parameter.

Expected impact:
- Reduced overfitting (smaller train-test gap)
- Better worst-group margin (regularization helps hard samples)
- Better parameter efficiency
- Improved combined score through better generalization
